review_notes: The doxology's verb is supplied by the selected reading r02 (εὐχαριστῶ), which the ASV renders *I thank*; the ASV's textual note records the competing *thanks be to God* reading but that is not re-decided here (rule 12).

variant_decisions.evidence: ASV text reads 'I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord', a finite verb of thanking = εὐχαριστῶ. The mapped textual_variant note 'Many ancient authorities read But thanks be to God' places the χάρις readings (r00-base, r01) in the margin, so the translators rendered r02 in the text.
